description: Snap-style 75/25 layout restructure. Re-anchor HoleViewer to the top ~75% full-width band, add a bottom ~25% felt Tray, re-parent the hand UI (%HandStrip + %ShootButton) into the tray, move the HUD/dev readouts into hole-region corners, hide decorative clutter, and make camera framing aspect-aware for the wider/shorter viewport. This is the foundation both later features build on; it must leave the game fully playable with the two gameplay tests green. Independent of FEAT-002/003 in concept but MUST land first because they attach to the Tray node and the re-anchored band it creates.
steps: PRIME + BASELINE (do this first, before any edit): run /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --headless --path /Users/m22stewa/Documents/Godot/Golf/.worktrees/snaplayout --import (fall back to --editor --quit if --import is unsupported); confirm .godot/ now exists. Then run each verification gate once on the UNTOUCHED tree and record the exact error set in this FEAT's findings as the accepted baseline (expected: 2 font-uid errors uid://csixfh5trj68q, but capture whatever this worktree actually emits).

In scenes/ui/main_ui.tscn, on the HoleViewer instance node (line ~117, parent='.'), override ALL eight layout props explicitly to defeat base-scene inheritance (hole_viewer.tscn root carries anchors_preset=9 and offset_right=800): anchor_left=0.0, anchor_top=0.0, anchor_right=1.0, anchor_bottom=0.75, offset_left=0, offset_top=0, offset_right=0, offset_bottom=0, grow_horizontal=2, grow_vertical=2. Keep the existing min_zoom=20.0 / max_zoom=100.0 overrides. Do NOT edit scenes/ui/hole_viewer.tscn.

In scenes/ui/main_ui.tscn add a new Tray PanelContainer (unique_name_in_owner=true) as a child of MainUI anchored anchor_top=0.75..anchor_bottom=1.0, full width (anchor_left=0, anchor_right=1, offsets 0, grow_horizontal=2, grow_vertical=2) with a thin dark near-opaque StyleBoxFlat panel as base/fallback. Inside Tray: MarginContainer 'TrayMargin' (~16px margins, extra bottom for the brass-rail read) > HBoxContainer 'TrayContent' (separation=24, alignment=1).

Re-parent %HandStrip (keeping unique_name_in_owner=true, its name, its StyleBoxFlat, and its Rows>%ClubRow+%ModifierRow children) into TrayContent with size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL; drop its floating bottom-center anchors (preset-7 / +-420 / -210 offsets). Re-parent %ShootButton (keeping unique_name_in_owner=true and its name) into TrayContent AFTER %HandStrip with size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER; drop its old float anchors. CRITICAL: do NOT rename or recreate these nodes and do NOT add any script edits for the four hand-UI unique names — unique_name_in_owner being preserved is what keeps main_ui.gd, hex_grid.gd, and the live-hand test green.

In scenes/ui/main_ui.tscn add a HoleHUD Control child of HoleViewer (MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE so it never steals aim input). Re-parent WindWidget (top-left corner), LieView + LieInfoPanel (left edge below Wind), HoleInfoLabel (top-right corner), GenerateButton + GenerateUniqueButton (top-right inset) under HoleHUD with corner anchors. Set unique_name_in_owner=true on WindWidget, LieView, HoleInfoLabel, GenerateButton, GenerateUniqueButton (LieInfoPanel already has it). Leave HoleViewer, ShotUI, DeckWidget as DIRECT children of MainUI (re-anchor/visibility only; do NOT re-parent them).

In scripts/ui/main_ui.gd switch the five moved nodes' @onready lookups from $Name to %-form: wind_widget -> get_node_or_null('%WindWidget') (or %WindWidget), lie_view -> %LieView, hole_info_label -> %HoleInfoLabel, generate_button -> %GenerateButton, generate_unique_button -> %GenerateUniqueButton. Leave shot_ui=$ShotUI, combined_deck_widget=$DeckWidget, hole_viewer=$HoleViewer unchanged, and leave the four hand-UI % lookups and all card-population logic unchanged.

In scenes/ui/main_ui.tscn set visible=false on Panel, icons, and the MainUI-level Label/Label2/Label3 (tiltshift already hidden). Do NOT delete any node or script (DeckWidget is a typed @onready: DeckWidget; deleting it would null/type-error on load). Keep DeckWidget and ModifierDeckUI hidden as today.

In scripts/hole_viewer.gd make _center_on_hole() (line ~216) aspect-aware: aspect = float(viewport.size.x)/float(viewport.size.y) with a 16/9 fallback on divide-by-zero; guard-skip framing and retry on next resize when viewport==null or viewport.size.y<=1; needed_for_z = hole_bounds.size.y * Z_FIT_FACTOR; needed_for_x = (hole_bounds.size.x * X_FIT_FACTOR)/aspect; target_zoom = clamp(max(needed_for_z, needed_for_x), min_zoom, max_zoom). Add tuning consts Z_FIT_FACTOR=0.55 and X_FIT_FACTOR=2.0. Keep _update_camera_transform() forward_shift unchanged.

In scripts/hole_viewer.gd._ready() (line ~83), after _setup_viewport(), connect viewport_container.resized to a new _on_viewport_resized() that calls _center_on_hole() ONLY when not tracking the ball and not mid-interaction (so a resize re-frames the hole without yanking the camera off a tracked ball during play).
Commit locally on the branch (do NOT push): message 'feat: snap-style 75/25 layout - hole band + felt tray, corner HUD, aspect-aware framing'.
acceptance_criteria: The 3D hole band occupies the top ~75% full width and a Tray PanelContainer (%Tray) occupies the bottom ~25% full width at any window size (anchor-based, no hardcoded 1920x1080 on HoleViewer/Tray).
%HandStrip and %ShootButton render inside the tray; all four of %HandStrip/%ClubRow/%ModifierRow/%ShootButton still carry unique_name_in_owner=true and resolve.
Running the live-hand wiring test exits 0 (16/16), proving the re-parent preserved the deal>select>Shoot loop.

A headless '--editor --quit' (or one-frame GOLF.tscn load) produces no errors beyond the captured baseline — the typed @onready vars and hex_grid._find_and_setup_ui()'s main_ui.generate_button read resolve without null/type errors.
verification: /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --headless --path /Users/m22stewa/Documents/Godot/Golf/.worktrees/snaplayout --editor --quit  (no new errors beyond the recorded baseline)
findings: BASELINE (captured after priming .godot/ via '--headless --import', exit 0; .godot/ confirmed present): all three gates are CLEAN in this primed worktree. (1) test_live_hand_wiring.tscn -> exit 0, 16/16, no ERROR lines. (2) test_turn_loop.tscn -> exit 0, 40/40, no ERROR lines. (3) '--headless --editor --quit' -> exit 0, ZERO error lines. The only non-PASS diagnostic anywhere is a single benign WARNING on the editor/import path: 'Detected another project.godot at res://assets/fly_camera_addon-...; folder will be ignored' (editor_file_system.cpp) — a WARNING, not an ERROR, and it does NOT appear on the test-scene or GOLF.tscn run paths. NOTE: the 2 expected font-uid errors (uid://csixfh5trj68q) did NOT surface in this primed worktree on any gate (editor-quit, both tests, or a 60-frame GOLF.tscn load); after priming they are absent. Accepted baseline for all later 'no new errors' judgments = {the single fly_camera_addon project.godot WARNING on editor/import path} plus, if they ever reappear, the 2 font-uid errors. ANY new ERROR line beyond that set is a regression. POST-CHANGE re-run: identical to baseline — editor-quit clean, test_live_hand_wiring 16/16 exit 0, test_turn_loop 40/40 exit 0, GOLF.tscn 60-frame headless load clean. LAYOUT NOTES for later FEATs: Tray is '%Tray' PanelContainer (anchor_top=0.75..1.0, full width) > MarginContainer 'TrayMargin' (margins 16/16/16/28) > HBoxContainer 'TrayContent' (sep=24, alignment=center). %HandStrip (SIZE_EXPAND_FILL) and %ShootButton (SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER) live inside TrayContent; all four hand-UI unique names (%HandStrip/%ClubRow/%ModifierRow/%ShootButton) preserved and resolving. HoleViewer now anchors 0..0.75 full width (all 8 layout props overridden) with child Control 'HoleHUD' (MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE) holding the corner HUD: %WindWidget (top-left), %LieView (left below wind), %LieInfoPanel (right edge, hidden by default), %HoleInfoLabel + %GenerateButton + %GenerateUniqueButton (top-right). ShotUI/DeckWidget/HoleViewer remain DIRECT children of MainUI. _center_on_hole() is now aspect-aware (Z_FIT_FACTOR=0.55, X_FIT_FACTOR=2.0, 16/9 fallback, guard-skip when viewport null or size.y<=1); viewport_container.resized -> _on_viewport_resized() re-frames only when idle (not tracking ball, not panning/rotating/pitching).
